reworkEvents.event: The common fixture path was absent during the first read attempt and appeared later; output.json was produced for the common fixture once it was available.

Command-created artifact writes for dist/output paths were rejected by the sandbox, so the package uses no-emit TypeScript validation and the smoke test compares the checked output.json artifact to fresh CLI stdout.

toolUseNotes: Used shell commands for inspection, TypeScript typechecking, and smoke execution.
Used apply_patch for all manual file creation and edits.
Did not use any SemaGraph tool, package, CLI, or MCP capability.
Did not infer, repair, or synthesize observations; all transition math is finite six-bit XOR and bit counting.

acceptanceChecks.name: State64 validation
acceptanceChecks.detail: CLI rejects states that do not match S64-[01]{6}.

acceptanceChecks.name: Scenario length validation
acceptanceChecks.detail: CLI rejects scenario chains with fewer than 2 states.

acceptanceChecks.name: Deterministic transition math
acceptanceChecks.detail: Adjacent masks, net mutation masks, distances, volatility classes, aggregate totals, histograms, and comparisons are computed without inference.

acceptanceChecks.name: TypeScript typecheck
acceptanceChecks.detail: npm.cmd run smoke executed tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit.
